data.name: Hussaina
data.gender_notes: Hussaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman follower of Husain ibn Ali, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the third Imam of Shia Muslims. The name Hussaina carries the meaning “Follower of Husain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hussaina usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of husain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dedicated to the service of Husain ibn Ali.
data.etymology: Hussaina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Husain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hussaina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
